Financial Perspective (Neutral)** - **Pros of using a credit card at checkout:** - Convenience (no need for cash or debit). - Potential rewards (cashback, points, or miles). - Fraud protection (disputes are easier to resolve than lost cash). - Buyer protection (some cards offer warranties or return policies). - Establishes credit history (if used responsibly). - **Cons/Risks:** - **Debt accumulation** if you don’t pay the full balance (high interest rates in North America, often 18–25%+). - Overspending (easier to swipe than hand over cash). - Fees (foreign transaction fees if used abroad, annual fees on premium cards). - Security risks (if card details are stolen, though chip technology mitigates this). ### **2.
